text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I came up with my own goals for this year and wrote them down in a New Year's card.

The New Year's card Mejiro McQueen handed me.
On it were written New Year's greetings and her goals.
—The goal written down was "Conquer the Kikuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, this year is the Classic year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"As an Umamusume, of course
I yearn for the Triple Crown races, and—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As a stayer, the Kikuka Sho
is the one race I simply cannot lose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if you win the Kikuka Sho, a victory at the Tenno Sho (Spring)
will naturally come into view.
choice_data_list: We're definitely going to win the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's decided, I'd like to start
training right away, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
choice_data_list: Let's build up a solid base of physical stamina.
First, let's go grab some lunch.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"So it is a matter of steadily doing what one normally does,
is it not?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me, then.
I shall carry it out flawlessly, just as always.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well, it is for nutritional replenishment.
Very well, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Since it is New Year's, the cafeteria
must surely be overflowing with osechi dishes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, there are so many options,
it's hard to decide what to eat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I see, so you wish to deepen your knowledge regarding the Classic stage, yes?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Mastering the course is essential to winning a race.
I shall make sure to learn it thoroughly.
